    | Property | Type | Description |

    | content | String | Resolution 본문 텍스트 |
    | sequence | Integer | 같은 Agenda 내 순서 |
    | sessionContext | String | 세션 정보 (예: "Thursday session", "Online") |

source_provenance_caveat: Phase2 indexed source has exact CQ3-1 sentence and CQ3-1~3-4 references mapping. Retained KO question JSON is untracked input, not falsely called an indexed historical original. The frozen English and original query are the immutable benchmark authority.
interpretation_to_judge: Does the exact original CQ3-1 mapping explicitly define documentary REFERENCES-based Tdoc share, despite effectiveness/led-to causal phrasing? No actual adoption, approval, temporal conversion, or causal attribution is inferred.
count_unit_to_judge: Distinct frozen Tdoc business records with recorded SUBMITTED_BY to exact canonical Huawei; a joint submission belongs to each recorded company, without fractional credits, legal entity mergers or company alias expansion. EXISTS Resolution citation contributes each submitted Tdoc at most once.
requested_role_to_judge: English asks the share alone. The original RETURN total and resolved counts are value provenance, not separately mandatory roles. Exact rational pair exposes both count units without introducing a precision/tolerance restriction.
cardinality_and_order_challenge: Original CQ3 defaults mention top10 CountDESC/CompanyASC for company ranking. This fixed-company scalar aggregation has one record, so all vs default10 cardinality and order are invariant without querying the requested value. No extra all-company ranking or limit is added.
existing_codec_development_exposure: RAN4 exact-share source-free codec/runtime and its empirical source gate already known. Their RAN4 result is not evidence for any Huawei value or RAN2 causal meaning. Same declared codec must be exposed uniformly in a fresh registered RAN2 runtime if semantic review passes.
known_adverse_interpretation: A reference need not mean adoption, technical agreement, positive approval, or actual effectiveness. A different reading that explicitly requires one of those remains unsupported; do not silently treat missing world outcomes as negative.
